description: This file contains initialization, helper functions, and testing setup for Gitweb, a web interface for Git repositories. It includes functions to initialize configuration variables, run tests, and check prerequisites for testing Gitweb functionality.

methods.name: gitweb_init
methods.description: Initializes the Gitweb configuration by creating a Perl config file and setting the script name based on installation status.

methods.name: gitweb_run
methods.description: Runs the Gitweb CGI script with specified query parameters and handles the output.
